text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A-An invitation to a dinner party...!? 
W-W-What in the world is the meaning of 
this!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it arrived safely♪ Fufu, you 
don't need to be so tense, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's hosted by someone who has been very 
kind to me in Japan. They're quite 
friendly, and above all—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She knows so much about medieval chivalric 
culture! Her collection of armor and 
swords is simply magnificent♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? When I told them about 
Durandal, they said, "I'd love to meet her 
in person and talk about chivalric romance 
all night!"♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Getting insight directly from a knight 
expert...?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful birthday this is♪ 
Fine-san, thank you so mu—Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I must compose myself. I was invited to 
such a prestigious occasion, after all. I 
must act more knightly, more calmly—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come now, Sir Durandal. No need to be 
so formal tonight. Just let your heart 
flutter and enjoy yourself♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but... Well, if Your Highness says 
so— Fufufu♪
